TextBlock.Text: ROOT: We have succeeded! We were able to pair the <color=orange>warp pads</color> without issue.

OENO: Excellent thinking, having us put that <color=orange>receiver</color> together. I'm surprised it was able to receive the <color=lightblue>Timber Hearth</color> warp pad's signal, given the distance, and the unique rotational pattern of <color=lightblue>Hollow's Lantern</color>.
ROOT: It is quite the miracle, but I do suppose it would just as easily pick up the signal of any other <color=orange>non-paired warp source</color>.
ROOT: Suppose a warp pad were to have its partner disconnected or destroyed... I wonder what would happen if it were to then be activated!
OENO: Certainly an interesting question to pose, but not one we should work to answer right now. We have-
ROOT: Oeno! The <color=orange>receiver</color> picked something else up!
OENO: ...How bizarre! You're right! I am logging the coordinates immediately... Now that we have the warp pad paired, we can set the receiver to monitor for similar signals in the future.

ROOT: These coordinates point towards <color=green>another star system</color>! As monumental of a detection as this otherwise would be, we have work to do- we must get back to testing these ores for our friends in the mines back on <color=lightblue>Timber Hearth</color>.
